“Royal Khaddi 2026” is a distinguished expression of authentic Khaddar, crafted from premium dyed cotton yarn to deliver a refined balance of natural elegance, durability, and exceptional softness. Its subtle lustre and smooth hand-feel create a sophisticated fabric experience while remaining wonderfully comfortable against the skin. Exclusively available through Kamalia Khaddar outlets across Pakistan and our official online store, with free nationwide delivery.
•	Fabric: Premium Royal Khaddi
•	Finish: Subtle Lustre with Refined Texture
•	Season: Four Season
•	Comfort: Breathable & Skin-Friendly
•	Length: 7 Meters & Width: 1 Yard
